Seattle smoked salmon dip.d: Hot-smoked fish worked into cream cheese and crème fraîche with dill, capers, lemon and horseradish. Toasted bagel chips.

Radio show popcorn.d: Popped in coconut oil, tossed with browned butter and sea salt.
Radio show popcorn.note: Bar radio stays on the call-in show.

Annie's dinner with Walter.d: Fillet roasted under parsley, grated lemon peel and bread crumbs. Steamed green beans, warm butter spooned over.

Valentine's heart cookies.d: Browned butter sugar cookies, hand cut, iced red and white.
Valentine's heart cookies.note: A pair on every saucer tonight.

Houseboat iced mocha.d: Strong coffee with dark chocolate melted through, cold milk over ice, whipped cream and cocoa.
Houseboat iced mocha.note: The way they take it in Seattle.
